csv_project_name: AE for SECOG Transportation Engineering Services
csv_scope_of_work: The Southeastern Connecticut Council of Governments (SECOG) is seeking the services of an on-call transportation engineer or transportation planning and engineering firm to assist in administering SECOG s transportation program. The selected firm/individual will assist the SECOG staff with Planning (PL) funded tasks carried out in support of regional transportation planning within Southeastern Connecticut. The selected firm will provide services in the fiscal years 2026 and 2027, not to exceed $300,000. Duties may include but are not limited to the following: MTP support including project estimation, acquisition of data. corridor studies/white papers/technical assistance (services might include data collection, analysis, synthesis, alternatives development, recommendations, preliminary plans(CAD and GIS) estimates, public outreach, phase and funding plans.) Assist SECOG in conducting other state/regional transportation funding programs including STP, TAP, CMAQ, Section 5310 and other formula and discretionary grants. Assist in reviewing local design plans, specifications, and cost estimates required for these grant programs. Supplementary planning required for implementation of CMP recommendations. Safety project planning including planning level engineering support for implementation of SAP recommendations. Complete Streets policy assistance- providing support to local municipalities for the creation of policies ensuring safe and equitable transportation access. Bike Ped Plan - planning level engineering to update the Bike and Pedestrian Plan and implement bicycle and pedestrian recommendations, data collection and analysis to update the existing plan. Local technical support- technical support to municipalities for regionally significant local transportation issues. Emerging technologies and issues - technical support and data collection/acquisition to respond to emerging technologies including but not limited to: EVs, EV charging, autonomous vehicles, parking management, connected vehicle technologies, etc. Freight planning - Technical support and data collection related to regional freight planning and freight land use and waste management. PL funded review of LOTCIP applications. Technical support for public outreach and stakeholder engagement (panel moderation, campaign materials, meeting logistics, etc. Direct Costs for permissible: data, data collection tools, public outreach expenses, printing, travel and food.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Planning/Master Planning, Waste Management, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
